Section: 1. Purpose and Policy Objectives

This Policy establishes the enterprise principles by which Northstar Financial accepts, measures, approves, monitors and escalates credit risk arising from lending activities. It is intended to keep individual credit decisions within approved risk appetite while allowing product-level procedures to impose more restrictive controls.
